decision.amino_acid_diversity_gate: Report exact unique amino-acid VH/VL pairs separately and never inflate it with synonymous nucleotide observations.
decision.native_observation_gate: At least 5.5 million authenticated native cell- or nucleotide-pair observations after quality filtering and source-level deduplication.
decision.sampling_gate: Cap and balance replay by study and donor before CDR specialization so clonal expansion does not dominate optimization.
